place.placeName: Thanjapureeswarar Sri Shiva Temple Aanandavalli Amman Temple
place.note: In all probability, this is the temple where the Vidyāpariṇayanāṭaka (see entry) was enacted.
Used to be surrounded by agrahāras. Has a nartana mandapam built by Serfoji II.
The temple has a Chola foundation with additions by Nāyakas and Marathas.
